ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

2. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 16
   C. 5
   D. 8

3. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 1, 6

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

6. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

7. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

8. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

11. Solve for x: x + 8 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 8
   D. 6

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 82

13. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

15. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 17
   C. 15
   D. 3

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

17. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

18. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

19. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 7

20. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

21. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

22. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

23. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 8

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 105
   C. 30
   D. 44

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
